# Create time entry — `redmine_create_time_entry`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_write_

Log hours against an issue or project with an activity type and comment — e.g. "log 3.5 hours on #456 for implementing auth". Exactly one of issue_id or project_id is required.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hours` | number | **yes** | Hours to log, must be positive, e.g. 3.5 for "log 3.5 hours on issue #456". |
| `issue_id` | integer | no | Issue to book against. Provide exactly one of issue_id or project_id. |
| `project_id` | integer | no | Project to book against. Provide exactly one of issue_id or project_id. |
| `spent_on` | string | no | Date the time was spent, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". Defaults to today. |
| `activity_id` | integer | no | Activity id (e.g. Development, Design); required by some Redmine instances. |
| `comments` | string | no | Short note describing the work, e.g. "implemented auth". |
| `user_id` | integer | no | Log on behalf of another user id. Requires elevated permission — Redmine returns 403 otherwise. |
| `custom_fields` | object[] | no | Custom-field values as { id, value } entries. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_create_time_entry",
  "arguments": {
    "hours": 3.5,
    "issue_id": 42
  }
}
```
